delete-account.text:
This will delete this Plex account from Reaparr! 

This will also delete all inaccessible Plex shared servers, Plex libraries and all media that is contained within. Any active downloads that are started or queued with this account will be canceled and deleted. Completed downloads will remain untouched.

download-segments.label: Download Segments
download-segments.text:
Reaparr supports multi-threaded downloading and can divide the media that will be downloaded into different parts and download each part individually. This tends to increase the overall download speed but the downside is that it will require extra time to merge the different parts afterwards into one complete media file.

Setting this value to 1 will disable multi-threaded downloading and download the media file as one complete file. The number of download segments has no influence on the speed of the media file being merged.
download-segments.title: Download Segments

section1.content: You are responsible for ensuring that your use of Reaparr complies with all applicable laws, including copyright laws, and the Terms of Service of any platforms you interact with. section2.content: You must have explicit ownership or permission to access the media content and servers you interact with using Reaparr. Unauthorized access or use of third-party servers or media is strictly prohibited.

section3.content: Reaparr is an independent tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with Plex Inc. or any other platform.
